services.name: Balloon rides
services.desc: Planning starts with you. The first step towards bringing the magic of colorful balloons to your event is visiting with Kansas City AeroSports’ team of professionals. You share your vision and we listen to what you need us to help you accomplish. Our team has vast experience flying in, coordinating and managing special events that include balloon festival flights, competition flights, evening balloon glows, VIP balloon rides, paid passenger rides, and tether rides in hot air balloons. There aren’t many things that will draw the awe and attention of a crowd more than the massive kaleidoscope of nylon fabric covering an open grassy area. blurb: Kansas City AeroSports has been uplifting corporate brands, community events and special celebrations since 1997. They deliver hot air balloon services and sales across the United States. Their offerings include branding and marketing, balloon events, and sales and training.
highlights: Over 20 years of experience in hot air balloon services
